normal.note: Femme de 21 ans, postéro-antérieur, thorax sans lésion (Häggström, CC0). Repères Dx et Sin. Pas de nom.
normal.caption_source: Posteroanterior chest radiograph ("X-ray") taken of a 21 year old woman who presented with pain on the left side of her thorax after colliding with another player during a soccer game. It shows a normal chest without any signs of injury. Dx and Sin stand for "right" and "left" respectively.

patho.author: Mikael Häggström, M.D.
patho.caption_source: AP chest X-ray of a 76 year old woman, who developed cough and labored breathing. First testing showed influenza B virus, and later a nasopharyngeal swab detected Haemophilus influenzae. The H influenzae presumably developed as an opportunistic infection secondary to the flu. This X-ray was taken 2 weeks after cultures and start of antibiotics, showing delayed pneumonic infiltrates that were only vaguely visible on initial (not shown) X-rays.
patho.note: Femme de 76 ans. Infiltrats du champ droit du patient (gauche de l'image). Pas de nom.
